changelog: Prepared By no longer fills itself in from the designer. A name is printed on the challan only when you set it on the order screen — otherwise a blank line is printed to write on.

The shop line on printed sheets now shows the phone number and address. It takes them from the branch, and falls back to Settings → Business, so set the mobile number there once. Blank parts no longer leave a stray dot.
Orders now has a Print list button. It prints exactly what is filtered on screen — every match, not just the page you can see — with a tick box against each job.
Orders can also be filtered by person: whose design it is, who took the order, or who accepted it. Filter to one person and press Print list, and you have their pending work to hand them.
New "Still pending (not delivered)" filter, which is what a hand-out sheet is usually for.
The sheet totals the jobs, what is still pending, the value and the balance due, and has Given to / Signature / Date at the foot.
